name: Mallaig
method: tidetimes.org.uk Mallaig vs its own Tobermory (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Tobermory: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: Height = offset + scale * Tobermory: Mallaig's range is ~9% bigger. Ullapool doesn't fit (90% of turns over 40 min apart). HW scatters ~8 min round the median. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Mallaig vs Tobermory, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-19 (every 3 day(s), 534 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
